articles.summary: TUPELO, Miss., Feb. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The board of directors of Renasant Corporation (NYSE: RNST) approved the payment of a quarterly cash dividend of twenty-three cents ($0.23) per share to be paid March 31, 2026, to shareholders of record as of March 17, 2026.
articles.title: Renasant Corporation Declares Quarterly Dividend
